name: When do I need general contractor plumbing coordination instead of hiring a plumber directly?

mainEntity.name: When do I need general contractor plumbing coordination instead of hiring a plumber directly?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should use general contractor plumbing coordination whenever your project involves multiple building trades, such as moving walls, updating tile, or replacing drywall alongside pipe adjustments. A standalone plumber handles pipes, but they typically do not repair framing, patch drywall, or waterproof custom tile around a shower valve. With HH Remodeling LLC managing the work, we schedule plumbing rough-ins right after custom framing adjustments and right before drywall installation. This practical handoff protects new surfaces, ensures proper backing for fixtures, and prevents costly delays between structural changes and plumbing hookups.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need GC coordination when your plumbing work overlaps with demolition, framing, drywall, or tile work, ensuring trades sequence properly without damaging finished surfaces.
